info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Connect Actions Members API
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Current User

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Returns information about the context user in the specified Experience Cloud site, including profile details, reputation, and community membership information.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud List Community Members

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results

params.name: q
params.description: Search term to filter members by name

items.docs: Returns a list of users in the specified Experience Cloud site. Supports pagination and filtering.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get User Reputation

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Returns the reputation score and level for a specific user within the Experience Cloud site.
